name: Voxel Hash Chunk Map
definition: A voxel hash map that divides 3D space into independent chunks, where each chunk is a cube of n x n x n voxels. This mitigates memory usage for large point cloud maps by allowing separate disk I/O and dynamic loading/unloading of regions.
summary: The Voxel Hash Chunk Map is a sparse 3D point cloud representation that uses hash-addressed cubic chunks to reduce memory overhead and allow dynamic region management.
